say:1:1012443001:0.text: Looking at this beautiful sea of flowers... It feels as if I've become three hundred years younger. I think I will compose a poem about the events that transpired here.
say:1:1012443001:0.source_cn: 望着这片美丽的花海，我仿佛一下子年轻了三百多岁，甚至想...

say:2:1012443002:0.text: But this is not the time for that... Bryon, look to the sky. Elona is looking for you.
say:2:1012443002:0.source_cn: 不过……还不是时候啊。布莱恩，看向天空吧，艾洛娜来找你了。

say:5:1012443004:1.text: Elona? I told you to stay in Ivoryshade. Why are you here...?
say:5:1012443004:1.source_cn: 艾洛娜？！我让她留在月影乡，她飞到这里，难道是……

say:8:1012443006:1.text: Bryon, what did Elona say? Has something happened to Lorsan?
say:8:1012443006:1.source_cn: 布莱恩！艾洛娜说了什么？是不是洛桑那边出事了？

say:9:1012443007:0.text: The Ivory Tree shows <style="highlight">signs of corruption</style>...
say:9:1012443007:0.source_cn: 皎月树出现了<style=highlight>腐化的迹...

say:11:1012443008:0.text: What?! Magister Merlin completed the purification ritual. How could the corruption have spread to Ivoryshade?
say:11:1012443008:0.source_cn: 什么……梅林大人已经施展了净化魔法，腐化怎么会蔓延到月影乡？
say:11:1012443008:0.male: What?! Magister Merlin completed the purification ritual. How could the corruption have spread to Ivoryshade?
say:11:1012443008:0.female: What?! Magister Merlin completed the purification ritual. How could the corruption have spread to Ivoryshade?

say:13:1012443009:0.text: It seems the current state of the Sylvan Egg isn't enough to overcome the corruption completely.
say:13:1012443009:0.source_cn: 看样子，现在的翡绿之卵还不足以完全根除腐化。

say:14:1012443010:3.text: The only reason you were able to cleanse this area was because Hewynn and Magister Merlin's combined magic triggered the remaining life force in the Sylvan Egg.
say:14:1012443010:3.source_cn: 你们能净化这片区域，是因为梅林大人和伊温的魔法，激活了...
say:14:1012443010:3.male: The only reason you were able to cleanse this area was because Hewynn and Magister Merlin's combined magic triggered the remaining life force in the Sylvan Egg.
say:14:1012443010:3.female: The only reason you were able to cleanse this area was because Hewynn and Magister Merlin's combined magic triggered the remaining life force in the Sylvan Egg.

say:15:1012443011:0.text: In other words, a part of Misarte's divine power was retained in the Sylvan Egg. It seems that the Sylvan Egg is actually <style="highlight">a vessel for storing power</style>.
say:15:1012443011:0.source_cn: 换言之，那是弥萨忒留存于翡绿之卵的部分神力。看样子，翡...

say:17:1012443013:0.source_cn: 贤者，能麻烦您解释得清楚些吗？

say:18:1012443014:1.text: To fully cleanse it, I'm afraid you'll have to destroy Eomir in order to retrieve the life force he stole from the Lucent Tree.
say:18:1012443014:1.source_cn: 想要完全净化流荧树，恐怕免不了和伊米尔决一死战，拿回被...

say:19:1012443015:1.text: And the purpose of the Sylvan Egg is to absorb this life force so that, even after slaying Eomir, it does not vanish.
say:19:1012443015:1.source_cn: 而翡绿之卵的作用，是完全吸纳这些力量，避免打败伊米尔后...

say:21:1012443016:1.text: But how can we find Eomir?
say:21:1012443016:1.source_cn: 可是我们要如何找到伊米尔的行踪？

say:22:1012443017:1.text: There is no need to be hasty. A path will appear.
say:22:1012443017:1.source_cn: 不必心急，道路自会出现。

say:23:1012443018:0.text: One tree does not make a forest. You'll need the strength of all your companions. For now, go and help Lorsan first.
say:23:1012443018:0.source_cn: 一木不能成林，你们需要同伴的力量，眼下，先去帮助洛桑吧。
